steps.question: How many icon sizes exist?
steps.why: One size, larger than the text.

steps.question: How big are icons next to text?
steps.why: Larger icons are easier to see.

steps.question: What icon style and stroke?
steps.why: A bold 2px stroke keeps every icon easy to see, for low vision and small screens.

steps.pick: radius.6: Buttons and inputs take the 6px corner: slightly rounded, never a pill, so they still read as clear fields and buttons.

steps.rule: The fill of a selected or current item, or a toggle that is on.
steps.pick: blue.light.100: a tint of the brand, 1.18:1 from content, always beside its edge (border.selected), so selection is never color alone.
steps.darkPick: blue.dark.100: a tint of the brand, 1.21:1 from content, always beside its edge (border.selected), so selection is never color alone.
